guides/rv-solar-not-charging.html.verified_by: Cloud 2026-09-28, external-review correction pass plus a fresh-context confirm round. The page explained the battery-first connection order with 'a panel connected to a controller with no battery on it has nowhere to put its current', which is bad physics: a panel is a current-limited source, so with an open input it simply rises to its open-circuit voltage and no current flows.
